title: DeLonge's meetings at the Pentagon and NASA

tellings.quote: A bunch of meetings start. So he's flown out to the Pentagon where he meets with someone and they say, "Okay, now you're going to NASA." Where he meets with some people. I think arguably you could say maybe Pete Worden who's a one-star NASA general may have been there.

plain: Around 2015, the musician Tom DeLonge is said to have been flown to the Pentagon for a meeting, then told he was going on to NASA to meet more people, possibly including Pete Worden, whom the teller calls a one-star NASA general. The researcher Jason Simosa tells Michels this without naming a source, and links Mike Carey and Neil McCasland to the meetings too. If true, it would mean senior officials quietly took part in DeLonge's UFO efforts.
